name: Create Showings

attributes.name: LeadId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the lead associated with the showing. Reference the Leads endpoint for any necessary associations.

attributes.name: UnitId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the unit that the interested party will be shown. Reference the Units endpoint for any necessary associations.

attributes.name: StartAt
attributes.description: The start time of the showing. The value must adhere to the ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ and the default time zone is Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

attributes.name: EndAt
attributes.description: The end time of the showing. The value must adhere to the ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ and the default time zone is Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

attributes.name: AssignedUserId
attributes.description: The AppFolio Property Manager user responsible for the showing. Reference the Users endpoint for any necessary associations.

attributes.name: Notes
attributes.description: A brief informative message about the showing

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the created showing

requestSample:
{
  "AssignedUserId": "80c5cb28-547f-11ec-bfa5-02975b268737",
  "EndAt": "2022-02-08T18:45:00Z",
  "LeadId": "71c5cb28-547f-11ec-bfa5-02975b268737",
  "Notes": "Prospect was very excited about the unit.",
  "StartAt": "2022-02-08T18:30:00Z",
  "UnitId": "91c5cb28-547f-11ec-bfa5-02975b268737"
}
